{{Quote|Proximity to ''Kashyyyk'', this ''farming moon'' has.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="Seeds" />}}
This '''farming moon''' was one of the three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==Geography==
[[File:Unidentified_farming_moon_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on the farming moon]]
The [[Moon/Legends|moon]] held some strategic value as a result of its proximity to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was covered with green [[Farm/Legends|farmlands]] and had a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], although it was filled with pollen. This [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] was inhabited by [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] and was home to a [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] [[Unidentified reptavian species|species]].<ref name="Seeds" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Battle on an unidentified farming moon|battle]] took place on the farming moon. [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] on the battlefield had trouble breathing because of the high amount of pollen in the moon's atmosphere, which clogged up their [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|helmet filters]]. This prompted [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to order his troops to remove their helmets.<ref name="Seeds" />
